final_qi.long_answer: Reference: [GG_5], [GG_6], [GG_11]. Explanation: The context indicates that sarcoglycan genes produce transmembrane proteins that are components of the dystrophin glycoprotein complex, which primarily connects the internal cytoskeleton to the plasma membrane and stabilizes the membrane, rather than directly stabilizing the cytoskeleton. While it is generally true that the cytoskeleton facilitates the motion of cellular contents, attributing the role of stabilizing the cytoskeleton to sarcoglycan proteins is misleading.
